title: The Way You'd Name a Key

mood.label: Braced and waiting
mood.summary: Braced and waiting: the world watched Washington after 'minor' US strikes on Iran's Qeshm island, while Kyiv and Taiz were hit and attackers scattered Ebola patients in eastern DRC. Markets steadied unevenly. New Zealand voted peacefully, and Qatar urged no waiting for a perfect moment.
